We simulated a combined topology but we need to ensure connections are correct. The subnet data:

Subnet1: resistors R1=2.222 between A-B, R2=4.445 between B-X1.

Subnet2: R1=5.4 between N_b1-X1, R2=17.5 between N_b1-X2, R3=35.0 between X1-X2.

Subnet3: R1=2.727 between X2-N1, R2=5.455 between N1-N2, R3=8.182 between N2-B.

We need combine all, but note resistor IDs conflict across subnets. Should rename uniquely. Also need ensure all nodes present: A, B, X1, X2, N_b1, N1, N2.

The combined topology we used: R1 (2.222) A-B, R2 (4.445) B-X1, R3 (5.4) N_b1-X1, R4 (17.5) N_b1-X2, R5 (35.0) X1-X2, R6 (2.727) X2-N1, R7 (5.455) N1-N2, R8 (8.182) N2-B.

That seems correct.

Now we should validate against measurements. Use validate_measurements tool.
